_comment: Which rights of the underlying share reach a token holder, per issuer programme: curated from the issuer dossiers' own claims (stocks/data/issuers/*.json), each with the source it rests on. Read by stocks/build-stocks-db.mjs into stocks-issuers.json; statuses and wording rules are in stocks/lib/holder-rights.js.

dividends.summary: Reinvested into more of the same stock, net of withholding tax; your displayed balance grows.

source.quote: Rather than distributing cash, the dividend is reinvested into additional shares of the same stock.

voting.summary: The note gives creditor rights only: no voting at the company's general meetings.

source.locator: Base Prospectus p. 83, s. 4.1.6 'Rights attached to the Securities'
source.quote: the Investors' respective creditors' rights do not consist of any shareholders' rights; thus, excluding all rights of attendance, dividend payments, other participation rights or voting rights at a general assembly

information.summary: No right to attend meetings or receive shareholder materials.

source.locator: Base Prospectus p. 83, s. 4.1.6 'Rights attached to the Securities'
source.quote: excluding all rights of attendance, dividend payments, other participation rights or voting rights at a general assembly

splits.summary: Splits and reverse splits change your balance through the token's on-chain multiplier.

source.quote: Corporate actions such as dividends, stock splits, and reverse splits are handled through an onchain rebasing mechanism.

takeovers.summary: Mergers are not named; if the stock stops trading the issuer may end the product and pay what it alone decides is fair value.

source.locator: Base Prospectus p. 118, Terms and Conditions clause IX.iii
source.quote: then this shall be a Termination Event at the sole discretion of the Issuer

dividends.summary: Reinvested into the stock, net of withholding tax; your displayed balance grows.

source.quote: Dividends are automatically invested back into the referenced stock and reflected in token pricing.
